page.overview:
Who is Heera Agneheart?

Heera Agneheart is a tiefling rogue/warlock and a member of The Re-Slayer's Take. She is played by Jasmine Bhullar.

Heera is a tiefling woman with yellowish ocher skin, a long tail, buffalo-like horns adorned with ribbons and peacock feathers, and wearing green and blue silks and a leather armor with henna designs. Although she has hooves, she wears boots.

After Farah accidentally hit her with a rock a piece of one of her horns broke, and although it was temporarily re-attached with sap and vines, that same day Heera used it as a projectile in a battle, destroying it in the process. She started using her family's horn and a bow as a sort of prosthetic.

She is confident and cunning, clever and decisive, described as a "con-artist", and pragmatic when it comes to achieving her goals. She is also grateful, appearing friendly to those who treat her well, but irritable to those who disappoint her. She seems to be good with kids, befriending them rather quickly, and she also loves animals, understanding them better than people.
